Fix the accounts-broker sign-in and verify-email pages rendering their shared CSS as visible page text: the style block was concatenated into the head without a `<style>` element, so browsers hoisted the raw CSS into the body and the pages rendered unstyled.

Authorize shared-workspace relay tunnels per explicit label: the frps NewProxy check now requires every claimed customDomain to be a single DNS label directly under the share's domain (rejecting the bare domain and the wildcard), matching the workspace's switch to explicit per-service claims. The accounts broker's share-authorize handoff now delivers its login callback to a validated ``callback_origin`` (the workspace's dedicated auth label) instead of the bare domain, and preserves the full ``next`` deep-link when it stays on the workspace -- both host-bearing values are checked against the share's domain so a signed token can never be redirected off-domain.
